description: Cross-language vector for the wire version a session is negotiated at (Section 12.1.7). A SessionInit proposes a protocol_version and the SessionAck that answers it must state the same one; the session runs at that version, and every live act is signed and verified under it. Each case sets protocol_version on a SessionInit and a SessionAck as it says, removing the member when the case omits it, and both suites pass the pair to the session manager's create_session, with legacy_replay when the case sets it, which must accept it and run at runs_at, or refuse it with error_code and error_message. Nothing is filled in from the other message or from an implementation's own version. The cases without legacy_replay whose SessionInit states the current version are also run through the initiator's client, which receives the SessionAck and must reach the same verdict before it signs anything. A new session establishes only at a version in establishment_wire_versions (Section 11.2.1): a pair that agrees on a version recognised only for verifying records is refused. A case with legacy_replay true passes the session manager's explicit legacy-replay option, which rebuilds a recorded session for verifying its records; it accepts any pair that agrees on a recognised version, and nothing else. The client never uses that option.
